issuer.description: The token issuer. Defaults per method; required for `oidc`.

match.description: Every entry must match a claim exactly; a list means "any of these".

ClaimValue.description: One value or a list of acceptable values for a claim.

Duration.description: A positive duration: a whole number and a unit, s, m, h, or d, such as `90s` or `8h`.

JoinMethod.description:
Where the bot's token comes from. Decides the default issuer and which
claims a rule must name.

oneOf.description: Any OIDC provider (`CircleCI`, `Buildkite`, Bitbucket, Argo, Tekton, and so on).

max_ttl.description: Credential lifetime: at most one hour, 15 minutes by default.

roles.description: Roles the bot's logins get, exactly as for people.
